name: When should I get a professional home value estimate?

mainEntity.name: When should I get a professional home value estimate?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider getting a professional home value estimate, typically from a real estate agent or appraiser, when you are planning to sell your home, refinance your mortgage, or are curious about your property's current market value. A professional estimate provides a more detailed analysis, incorporating on-site evaluation and deeper local market insights specific to areas like Aventura or Key Biscayne, which AVMs cannot provide.
acceptedAnswer.description: Get a professional estimate when planning to sell, refinance, or if you need a more detailed analysis of your home's market value.
